name: Dora D. Sandoval
office: Little Lake City School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5 (Unexpired term ending December 12, 2028)

items.text: Dora Sandoval is a former member of the Little Lake City School District Board of Education. In 2018 she was the board vice president. She is self-employed. She says her top priorities are rebuilding trust with parents, teachers, staff, and community through open communication and collaboration, and promoting fiscal responsibility, transparency, and accountability.
